notes.note: Titan does not implement variadic parameters (5.4.3); its syntax error on '...' is a Titan limitation. Same for 05.04.03_test_002..009 and _011.
Ambiguity: reading 1 chosen; the variadic parameter has no default value, so absent/skipped yields an empty record of.
Violates the 'without any additional ellipsis' part (p := v_list...). The actual-parameter ellipsis is not in the annex A BNF; ASCII '...' as in the clause examples is used.
Titan errors are follow-up errors of its missing variadic support.
Covers both a recursive function call and a recursive altstep invocation as an alternative of the altstep itself.
Tested as reject: '00' is not a valid representation of zero (Number ::= NonZeroNum {Num} | "0").
Ambiguity: reading 1 (dot) chosen; the spec examples written with comma are tested with a dot.
Titan does not support subtyping of map types; list subtyping of a map from an existing parent type is allowed per table 3 and the example in 6.2.15.
Ambiguity: reading 1 chosen (address not subtypable). Titan accepts it as it treats address as a plain alias of integer; the test may be disputable since address is defined by an arbitrary type.
Ambiguity: reading 1 chosen (port type not subtypable); same reading for component (test_028) and default (test_029).
Titan does not support subtype constraints on array types; table 3 allows list subtyping of arrays from an existing parent type.
Tested as reject: list subtyping directly at the first declaration of a record type (not allowed by the note and not by the BNF). The positive part is covered by test_018..023.
